engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: No or Incorrect Basic Setting / Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:
stepByStepSolution:
Gerçekleştirin: Steering Limit Stop Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon: 
Make sure the Ignition is ON and the Engine is Running.
Center Steering Wheel (±10°) and hold it centered for about 5 Seconds.
Turn Steering Wheel completely to the Left and hold there for about 10 Seconds.
Turn Steering Wheel completely to the Right and hold there for about 10 Seconds.
Center Steering Wheel (±10°).
Switch Engine and Ignition OFF.
Switch Ignition ON.
Wait about 5 Seconds.
Steering Assist Warning Lamp should turn OFF (If it doesn't, Gerçekleştirin: a short Test Drive).
Make sure the Ignition is ON and the Engine is Running.
Center Steering Wheel (±10°) and hold it centered for about 5 Seconds.
Turn Steering Wheel completely to the Left and hold there for about 10 Seconds.
Turn Steering Wheel completely to the Right and hold there for about 10 Seconds.
Steering Assist Warning Lamp should turn OFF (If it doesn't, Gerçekleştirin: a short Test Drive).
technicalNotes:
When this DTC will not clear in Mk70 and MK60 ESP equipped (1K) Golf models see the WSS (Wheel Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri) notes Here.
The Steering Limit Stop Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:  page contains several additional notes if the procedure is not successful.
